note: Nhap tay cho tab Tai chinh (CFO) -> Tom tat cho BOD (V12.17). Sua truc tiep tren GitHub; dashboard doc lai sau ~1 phut. Khong ghi so du ngan hang hay ten nha cung cap vao day (repo public) — so du lay tu kho tien mat rieng (CASH_WRITE_KEY).

fx.note: VND per USD. V12.22 (16/11/2026): chu DN chot ty gia tham khao 26.000 d/USD cho moi khoan quy doi VND -> USD (truoc do dashboard 22.000, ke toan 26.100). opex_monthly.json 01-09/2026 da quy doi lai (USD moi = USD cu x 22.000 / 26.000); thang moi nhap theo 26.000. Doi ty gia: sua ca book_rate va accountant_rate o day roi quy doi lai opex_monthly.

cash_calendar.note: next_amazon_settlement = ngay ket thuc ky settlement Amazon gan nhat sap toi (YYYY-MM-DD) — lay trong Seller Central > Payments; factory_deposit_pct = % da coc khi dat hang (phan con lai tra truoc khi xuat). V12.22 (16/11/2026): shipmonk_pay_lag_days 21 -> 15 (han tra hoa don ShipMonk = ket ky + 15 ngay, theo due date tren app); ads_card_day = ngay Meta + Google thu tien chi tieu CUA THANG TRUOC (hoa don thang; vd hoa don T7 tra 18/08); amazon_ads_day = ngay tra hoa don Amazon Ads cua thang truoc (ACH tu ngan hang, KHONG tru vao payout); sales_tax_day = ngay Numeral nop sales tax Shopify cua thang truoc.

meta_credit.note: V12.23 (17/11/2026): han muc tin dung Meta (Billing & payments > Credit limit, USD) cho the canh bao 'Han muc tin dung Meta so voi toc do chay ads' tren tab Tai chinh. pay_lead_days = so ngay tu luc chuyen khoan toi luc Meta ghi nhan (Meta: chuyen khoan ~5 ngay + 2-3 ngay hien tren tai khoan). Meta doi han muc thi sua 'limit'.

payables_note: payables_manual = khoan phai tra nhap tay cho khoi 'Phai tra' tren tab Tai chinh (khoan dashboard khong tu tinh duoc). Moi dong: {"label": {"vi": "...", "en": "..."}, "amount": 12345, "due": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "..."}. KHONG ghi ten nha cung cap hay so tai khoan (repo public). Xoa dong khi da tra.
